name: Sanjou Minori
source:
Teacher of class 2-C, advisor of the volunteer department.

Easygoing and always smiling for the best, but introverted at time. Though she boasts maximum effort for the voluntary division, she backs out occasionally. For some reason, Sanjou has difficulties transforming into her magical girl form.
